acceptanceCriteria: selfTest(pack, source) loads each case.json into an in-memory Fs, scopes its sorted file keys, runs the rule's enforcer bound by rule id with the case trigger
violating needs non-empty expectRules all found; passing yields no finding with the rule id; missing or malformed case.json fails CDX-E212/E213; all builtin packs pass
diagnosis: BUG-0095: selfTest runs each enforcer with an empty scope and never reads case.json, so no fixture proves a rule (SPEC 4.4.1 case file, 4.4.4). Enforcers also bind to loader ports, so a case needs enforcers re-resolved against an in-memory Fs holding only the case files.
